name: excalidraw
description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams
readme: An open source virtual hand-drawn style whiteboard. Collaborative and end-to-end encrypted. Create beautiful hand-drawn like diagrams, wireframes, or whatever you like. 💯 Free & open-source. 🎨 Infinite, canvas-based whiteboard. ✍️ Hand-drawn like style. 🌓 Dark mode. 🏗️ Customizable. 📷 Image support. 😀 Shape libraries support. 🌐 Localization (i18n) support. 🖼️ Export to PNG, SVG & clipboard. 💾 Open format - export drawings as an .excalidraw json file. ⚒️ Wide range of tools - rectangle, circle, diamond, arrow, line, free-draw, eraser... ➡️ Arrow-binding & labeled arrows. 🔙 Undo / Redo. 🔍 Zoom and panning support.
